# Forage Switzerland

> A free guide to wild food in Switzerland: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 29 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Brennnessel, Ortie, Ortica. In season March to June.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Bärlauch, Ail des ours, Aglio orsino. In season March to May.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Löwenzahn, Dent-de-lion, Tarassaco. In season March to October.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Giersch, Égopode, Girardina. In season March to June.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Vogelmiere, Mouron des oiseaux, Centocchio. In season March to November.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Sauerampfer, Oseille, Acetosa. In season April to August.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis acetosella; Waldsauerklee, Oxalis petite oseille, Acetosella. In season April to September.
- [Garlic mustard](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/garlicmustard/): Alliaria petiolata; Knoblauchsrauke, Alliaire, Alliaria. In season March to June.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Weißer Gänsefuß, Chénopode blanc, Farinello. In season May to September.
- [Ribwort plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/plantain/): Plantago lanceolata; Spitzwegerich, Plantain lancéolé, Piantaggine. In season April to September.
- [Watercress](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/watercress/): Nasturtium officinale; Brunnenkresse, Cresson, Crescione. In season March to October.
- [Hop shoots](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/hops/): Humulus lupulus; Hopfensprossen, Jets de houblon, Bruscandoli. In season March to May.
- [Spruce tips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/spruce/): Picea abies; Fichtenspitzen, Bourgeons d'épicéa, Germogli di abete. In season May to June.
- [Good King Henry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/goodking/): Blitum bonus-henricus; Guter Heinrich, Épinard sauvage, Buon Enrico. In season April to July.
- [Sweet woodruff](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/woodruff/): Galium odoratum; Waldmeister, Aspérule odorante, Asperula. In season April to May.
- [Blackberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/blackberry/): Rubus fruticosus; Brombeere, Mûre, Mora. In season August to September.
- [Wild raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/raspberry/): Rubus idaeus; Himbeere, Framboise, Lampone. In season July to August.
- [Bilberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/bilberry/): Vaccinium myrtillus; Heidelbeere, Myrtille, Mirtillo. In season July to August.
- [Lingonberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/lingonberry/): Vaccinium vitis-idaea; Preiselbeere, Airelle rouge, Mirtillo rosso. In season August to October.
- [Wild strawberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/strawberry/): Fragaria vesca; Walderdbeere, Fraise des bois, Fragolina di bosco. In season June to July.
- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus nigra; Holunderbeere, Holder, Baie de sureau, Bacca di sambuco. In season August to September.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus nigra; Holunderblüte, Fleur de sureau, Fiori di sambuco. In season May to June.
- [Sloe](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/sloe/): Prunus spinosa; Schlehe, Prunelle, Prugnolo. In season September to November.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/rosehip/): Rosa canina; Hagebutte, Cynorrhodon, Rosa canina. In season September to November.
- [Rowan berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/rowan/): Sorbus aucuparia; Vogelbeere, Eberesche, Sorbier des oiseleurs, Sorbo degli uccellatori. In season August to October.
- [Hawthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/hawthorn/): Crataegus monogyna; Weißdorn, Aubépine, Biancospino. In season September to October.
- [Crab apple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/crabapple/): Malus sylvestris; Holzapfel, Pommier sauvage, Melo selvatico. In season September to October.
- [Sea buckthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/seabuckthorn/): Hippophae rhamnoides; Sanddorn, Argousier, Olivello spinoso. In season August to October.
- [Wild blackcurrant](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/blackcurrant/): Ribes nigrum; Schwarze Johannisbeere, Cassis, Ribes nero. In season July to August.
- [Cornelian cherry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/cornel/): Cornus mas; Kornelkirsche, Tierlibaum, Cornouiller mâle, Corniolo. In season August to September.
- [Barberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/barberry/): Berberis vulgaris; Berberitze, Sauerdorn, Épine-vinette, Crespino. In season September to October.
- [Juniper berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/juniper/): Juniperus communis; Wacholder, Genièvre, Ginepro. In season September to November.
- [Hazelnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/hazelnut/): Corylus avellana; Haselnuss, Noisette, Nocciola. In season August to October.
- [Sweet chestnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/chestnut/): Castanea sativa; Edelkastanie, Marroni, Châtaigne, Castagna. In season October to November.
- [Walnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/walnut/): Juglans regia; Walnuss, Baumnuss, Noix, Noce. In season September to October.
- [Beechnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/beechnut/): Fagus sylvatica; Buchecker, Faîne, Faggiola. In season September to October.
- [Swiss stone pine nuts](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/stonepine/): Pinus cembra; Arve, Zirbe, Arolle, Cembro. In season September to October.
- [Meadowsweet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/meadowsweet/): Filipendula ulmaria; Mädesüß, Reine-des-prés, Olmaria. In season June to August.
- [Lime blossom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/linden/): Tilia cordata; Lindenblüte, Tilleul, Tiglio. In season June to July.
- [Wild chamomile](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/chamomile/): Matricaria chamomilla; Kamille, Camomille, Camomilla. In season June to August.
- [Wild thyme](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/thyme/): Thymus serpyllum; Feldthymian, Serpolet, Timo serpillo. In season June to August.
- [Yarrow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/yarrow/): Achillea millefolium; Schafgarbe, Achillée millefeuille, Achillea. In season June to September.
- [Red clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/redclover/): Trifolium pratense; Rotklee, Trèfle des prés, Trifoglio pratense. In season May to September.
- [Chanterelle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/chanterelle/): Cantharellus cibarius; Pfifferling, Eierschwamm, Chanterelle, Girolle, Gallinaccio, Finferlo. In season July to October.
- [Porcini](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/porcini/): Boletus edulis; Steinpilz, Cèpe de Bordeaux, Porcino. In season August to October.
- [Giant puffball](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/puffball/): Calvatia gigantea; Riesenbovist, Vesse-de-loup géante, Vescia gigante. In season July to September.
- [Chicken of the woods](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/chickenwoods/): Laetiporus sulphureus; Schwefelporling, Polypore soufré, Poliporo sulfureo. In season May to September.
- [Hedgehog mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/hedgehog/): Hydnum repandum; Semmelstoppelpilz, Pied-de-mouton, Steccherino dorato. In season August to November.
- [Cleavers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/cleavers/): Galium aparine; Klettenlabkraut, Gaillet gratteron, Attaccamani. In season February to May.
- [Hairy bittercress](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/bittercress/): Cardamine hirsuta; Behaartes Schaumkraut, Cardamine hérissée. In season January to December.
- [White and red deadnettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/deadnettle/): Lamium album; Taubnessel, Lamier blanc, Falsa ortica. In season March to September.
- [Ground ivy](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/groundivy/): Glechoma hederacea; Gundermann, Lierre terrestre, Edera terrestre. In season March to June.
- [Wild cherry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/wildcherry/): Prunus avium; Vogelkirsche, Merisier, Ciliegio selvatico. In season June to July.
- [Sweet violet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/sweetviolet/): Viola odorata; Duftveilchen, Violette odorante, Viola mammola. In season February to April.
- [Wood avens root](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/woodavens/): Geum urbanum; Echte Nelkenwurz. In season March to October.
- [Water mint](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/watermint/): Mentha aquatica; Wasserminze, Menthe aquatique, Menta acquatica. In season May to September.
- [Wild marjoram](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/marjoram/): Origanum vulgare; Dost, Wilder Majoran, Origan, Origano. In season June to September.
- [Lamb's lettuce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/lambslettuce/): Valerianella locusta; Feldsalat, Nüsslisalat, Mâche, Doucette, Valerianella. In season January to December.
- [Wild chives](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/wildchives/): Allium schoenoprasum; Schnittlauch, Ciboulette, Erba cipollina. In season May to August.
- [Birch sap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/birchsap/): Betula pendula; Birkensaft, Sève de bouleau, Linfa di betulla. In season March to April.
- [Cherry plum](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/cherryplum/): Prunus cerasifera; Kirschpflaume, Myrobolan. In season July to August.
- [Stone bramble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/stonebramble/): Rubus saxatilis; Steinbeere. In season July to August.
- [Bird cherry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/birdcherry/): Prunus padus; Traubenkirsche. In season July to August.
- [Iceland moss](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/icelandmoss/): Cetraria islandica; Isländisch Moos. In season May to October.
- [Mountain sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/mountainsorrel/): Oxyria digyna; Säuerling. In season June to August.
- [Heather flowers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/plants/heather/): Calluna vulgaris; Besenheide. In season August to September.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower syrup (Holunderblütensirup)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/elderflower-syrup/): Flower heads steeped with lemon for two days, strained and boiled with sugar. Topped up with water or sparkling water.
- [Spruce tip syrup (Fichtenspitzensirup)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/spruce-tip-syrup/): Young spruce tips layered with sugar or simmered into a resinous syrup, for tea, coughs and desserts.
- [Linden blossom tea (Lindenblütentee)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/linden-blossom-tea/): Dried lime flowers steeped as a calming evening tea.
- [Rose hip tea (Hagebuttentee)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/rose-hip-tea/): Dried rose hips simmered into a ruby tea.
- [Woodruff punch (Maibowle)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/woodruff-punch/): Wilted woodruff steeped briefly in white wine and sparkling wine.
- [Dandelion salad (Löwenzahnsalat)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/dandelion-salad/): Young dandelion leaves with warm bacon, croutons and egg.
- [Elderflower fritters (Holunderküchlein)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/elderflower-fritters/): Flower heads dipped in beer batter, fried and dusted with sugar.
- [Roasted chestnuts (Marroni)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/roasted-chestnuts/): Scored chestnuts roasted until the shells split, sold hot in winter streets.
- [Wild herb salad (Wildkräutersalat)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/wild-herb-salad/): Mixed wild greens with flowers and a mustard dressing.
- [Wild garlic pesto (Bärlauchpesto)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Wild garlic blended with sbrinz or parmesan, nuts and olive oil.
- [Rose hip jam (Hagebuttenkonfitüre)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/rose-hip-jam/): Seeded rose hips cooked to a tangy orange purée with sugar.
- [Rowan jelly (Vogelbeergelee)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Frozen then cooked rowan berries with apple, set into a bittersweet jelly for game.
- [Bilberry jam (Heidelbeerkonfitüre)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/bilberry-jam/): Mountain bilberries cooked with sugar and lemon.
- [Wild garlic spätzle (Bärlauchspätzli)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/wild-garlic-sp-tzle/): Spätzle dough blended with wild garlic, with browned butter and cheese.
- [Nettle soup (Brennnesselsuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/nettle-soup/): Young nettles simmered with potato and onion, blended with cream.
- [Good King Henry with polenta](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/good-king-henry-with-polenta/): Alpine wild spinach wilted with butter, served on polenta.
- [Chestnut gnocchi (Gnocchi di castagne)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/chestnut-gnocchi/): Ticino gnocchi of chestnut flour and potato with sage butter.
- [Bilberry tart (Heidelbeerwähe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/bilberry-tart/): Flat Swiss tart of bilberries in a custard of cream and egg.
- [Engadine nut tart (Engadiner Nusstorte)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/engadine-nut-tart/): Shortcrust filled with caramelised walnuts and cream.
- [Vermicelles](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/vermicelles/): Sweet chestnut purée piped into noodles over meringue and cream.
- [Elderberry soup (Holundersuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/elderberry-soup/): Cooked elderberries thickened with semolina and apple.
- [Cornelian cherry jelly (Tierlibaum-Gelee)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/cornelian-cherry-jelly/): Ripe cornelian cherries set into a ruby jelly.
- [Wild strawberries with cream](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/wild-strawberries-with-cream/): Wild strawberries with meringue and double cream from the Gruyère region.
- [Birch sap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/birch-sap/): Fresh spring sap, chilled.
- [Lamb's lettuce with egg (Nüsslisalat)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/lamb-s-lettuce-with-egg/): Nüsslisalat with chopped egg, bacon and croutons.
- [Chanterelle toast (Eierschwämmli-Toast)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/chanterelle-toast/): Chanterelles in cream on toast, a Swiss restaurant classic.
- [Porcini risotto (risotto ai funghi porcini)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/porcini-risotto/): Ticino risotto with porcini.
- [Wild chive potatoes (Gschwellti)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/wild-chive-potatoes/): Jacket potatoes with quark and alpine chives.
- [Elderberry and plum jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ch/dishes/elderberry-and-plum-jam/): Holunder and plum jam.
